description: Figure 6b illustrates the relationship between the hyperparameter N and the Area Under the Curve (AUC). The x-axis is labeled “N”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 20, and has tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “AUC”, has a linear scale, ranges from approximately 650 to 1000, and has tick labels at intervals of 100. There is one line displayed, colored blue and solid. Starting at N=0, the AUC is approximately 670, increasing to approximately 980 at N=20. The line exhibits a generally increasing trend with a slight plateau between N=10 and N=15, where the AUC values are approximately 950 and 970 respectively.
